Name: Nanami Custom NPC (Jujutsu Kaisen)
Author: OurpleKay
Description:
[size=2][b][img]https://imgur.com/W4lVEIj.png[/img]﻿[/b][/size][u][size=2][i][b]
[/b][/i][/size]
[size=3][b]-Description-[/b][/size][/u]

[b]Nanami[/b] is a customized new [b]NPC[/b] that you can add into your game in Stardew Valley. He functions as any other NPC in the game.
He does [b]NOT[/b] replace any other NPC.


- He is [b]dateable[/b], and you can [b]marry[/b] him.
- He has his own beach house.
- He has his own spouse room & patio.
- He shows up to all the festivals. Even the new [b]Desert Festival[/b][b] [/b]as well as the [b]Night market[/b].
- His birthday is set on [b]Summer 3[/b].
- He does have some [b]unique dialogue[/b] for specific gifts you give him.
- He is compatible with extension packs such as [i][b]Stardew Valley Expanded.[/b] (Beach house not included)
[/i]

[i](1 Heart event has been added)
[/i]

[b](KNOWN BUGS)

'Nanami won't move'
[/b]- If you're playing on an old save file, Nanami wont move from his starting point for the whole day. [b]However[/b] [b]he will continue with his schedule the next day!

'Nanami stuck in adventurer's guild'
[/b]- If you've had previous version installed (before 1.1.5) Nanami's disposition has been changed to his beach house. He will still be at the Adventurer's Guild for the first day, (unless you have a brand new farm) To fix this issue you just need to wait til the next day and he will function like normal again.

[img]https://imgur.com/57JW4Rq.png[/img]

﻿[b]1.1.5[/b]
- Added house on the beach.
- Added spouse room & patio.

﻿[b]1.0.4
[/b]- Updated format.
- Added content for Movie Theater.

[b]1.0.3
[/b]- Fixed issue so Nanami and Kent don't stand in the same spot at the Saloon in year 2..


[size=4][b][u][img]https://imgur.com/Ukmrp5P.png[/img]﻿
[/u][/b][/size]1.[b] Install Smapi:[/b] https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
2. [b]Install Content Patcher: [/b]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915
3. [b]Download this mod.
[/b]4. [b]Unzip mod into Stardew Valley Mods folder in your files.
[/b](If you're new at installing mods I recommend watching a youtube tutorial on it) 


[size=4][b]If there are issues with the installment try this:

[/b][/size]- Install [b]WinRAR[/b]
- Install Choso mod again
- use the "[b]Extract to Nanami JJK Custom NPC[/b]'" option

The zipped file will then give you a [b]folder[/b] that you can drag into the Stardew mods folder. And it should work after that!


[size=4][u][img]https://imgur.com/1J9nbu6.png[/img]
[/u][/size][size=2][i](I'd recommend downloading NPC Map Locations by[/i][color=#f4f4f4][i] Bouhm so you can check his whereabouts wherever & whenever you want lol)[/i]
